svg.title: Cohort confidence for a fixed day-180 profit target
svg.desc: Good and bad same-price source probabilities update from identical prelaunch evidence as their own cohort data arrives. Two equally priced fictional sources share the same prelaunch evidence and first receive the same prediction. As the same fixed day-70 cohort in each world accumulates observations, probabilities update toward different outcomes. Each point refits only records available at that cutoff and forecasts the same day-180 contribution under hold-current future conditions. The threshold is two cents of margin per originally acquired lead. A classification is above target at p≥95%, below target at p≤5%, inconclusive otherwise. This is a model probability, not validated 95% reliability; repeated cutoffs are dependent and later evidence can reverse the classification. It is separate from first-payback-by-day-425.
